title: Shrimp Pilaf with Turkish Flair
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish loaded with succulent shrimp, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Turkish Pilaf Mix
ingredients.notes: available in most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the pilaf mix and stir to combine.
Add the smoky paprika, salt, and lemon juice. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in chopped parsley and serve hot.
